# Mise UI

> UI that explains itself. shadcn-registry React components and AI-era states, each with the psychology behind it and an agent skill.

Site: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev
Registry: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/<name>.json (theme first: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/theme.json)
Agent skill: https://github.com/kimjusnu/miseui/tree/main/skills/miseui
Getting started: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/docs

## Blocks

- [Chat Assistant](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/chat-assistant): A full AI chat screen that shows the model working: steps, tool calls, streaming text and a composer that swaps Send for Stop. — Labor illusion. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/chat-assistant.json
- [Dashboard Overview](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/dashboard-overview): A product dashboard built around one number: a large metric with its chart, a quieter row under it, recent activity and the one thing that needs you. All figures shown are sample data. — Visual hierarchy: one number first. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/dashboard-overview.json
- [Empty State](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/empty-state): A first screen that gives people somewhere to start, with one action and three worked examples. — Blank page paralysis. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/empty-state.json
- [Feature Bento](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/feature-bento): An asymmetric feature grid: mixed cell sizes, live visuals built from kit effects in some cells and large type in the others. The features shown are sample content. — Aesthetic-usability effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/feature-bento.json
- [Landing Hero](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/landing-hero): A left-aligned marketing hero with one message, two actions and a live product preview built from real components, not a screenshot. The call and the people in it are sample content. — Serial position effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/landing-hero.json
- [Login Form](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/login-form): A split login screen with labels that stay visible, inline errors, a password you can reveal and a calm brand panel. — Recognition over recall. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/login-form.json
- [Pricing Table](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/pricing-table): Three plans with one dominant centre, an honest yearly anchor and feature rows you can read straight across. — Default effect and anchoring. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/pricing-table.json
- [Settings Page](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/settings-page): A settings screen in grouped rows, with a save bar that appears only when something changed and a destructive area kept well away from the rest. The person and plan shown are sample data. — Chunking and forgiveness. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/settings-page.json
- [Signup Steps](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/signup-steps): A sign-up that asks one question at a time, starts with real progress on the bar and never ticks consent for anyone. — Goal-gradient effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/signup-steps.json

## AI states

- [Reasoning Steps](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/reasoning-steps): Collapsed timeline of the model's steps; the header names the current one, the body shows them all. — Progressive disclosure. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/reasoning-steps.json
- [Streaming Text](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/streaming-text): Reveals arriving text character by character at reading speed, with a caret that marks where the next word lands. — Perceived latency. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/streaming-text.json
- [Thinking Indicator](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/thinking-indicator): Three breathing dots and a live label that tell the user the model is working, and on what. — Visibility of system status · labor illusion. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/thinking-indicator.json
- [Tool Call Card](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/tool-call-card): Collapsible record of one tool call: name, status, duration, and the exact input and output on demand. — Transparency builds trust. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/tool-call-card.json
- [Voice Wave](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/voice-wave): Bars that rise with the microphone level so the user can see they are being heard, and see when they are not. — Visibility of system status. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/voice-wave.json

## Forms

- [Angle Slider](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/angle-slider): A dial for rotation and other circular values: drags one to one under pointer capture, steps by keyboard, wraps past 360, with a ring, a marked compass, a small knob and a 270 degree gauge. — Natural mapping. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/angle-slider.json
- [Button](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/button): Press target that answers on pointer-down: a 3% dip in 100 ms, so the click feels acknowledged. — Doherty threshold. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/button.json
- [Button Group](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/button-group): Related actions joined under one border, across or down, including a main action with a menu of its alternatives. — Law of common region. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/button-group.json
- [Cascader](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/cascader): Pick from nested options: columns on wide screens, one level at a time on phones, with search, full keyboard, lazy children and the path shown in the trigger. — Hick's law. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/cascader.json
- [Checkbox](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/checkbox): Square toggle that fills and draws its check within 150 ms of the press, and announces the change through aria-checked. — Immediate feedback. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/checkbox.json
- [Clipboard](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/clipboard): One-press copy with a clear result: a lone icon, a code line, a read-only field or a labelled block, and a safe way out when the browser refuses. — Visibility of system status. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/clipboard.json
- [Color Picker](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/color-picker): A saturation square, hue and opacity sliders, typed hex and presets, in four layouts, with a thumb that never lags behind the hand. — Direct manipulation. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/color-picker.json
- [Combobox](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/combobox): A searchable select for long lists, single or multiple, with people rows, section headers, chips and loading built in. — Hick's law. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/combobox.json
- [Date Picker](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/date-picker): A calendar with no date library: single days or ranges, limits, a full keyboard grid and any locale, in four layouts. — Recognition over recall. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/date-picker.json
- [Editable](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/editable): Text that turns into a field in place without moving the page: Enter commits, Escape reverts, leaving commits or reverts by prop, with validation and optional buttons. — Direct manipulation. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/editable.json
- [Field](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/field): Gives any control a label, description, error and required mark, and wires the ids and aria attributes so nobody has to remember them. — Proximity. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/field.json
- [File Upload](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/file-upload): A real drop zone and file input with limits, clear errors and a progress list, and no network code of its own. — Error prevention. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/file-upload.json
- [Filter Chips](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/filter-chips): Filters a list you already have: chips with result counts, an all chip, a clear button and dead ends disabled. — Information scent. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/filter-chips.json
- [Icon Button](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/icon-button): A glyph-only button that cannot be shipped without a name, with four surfaces, a pending state that keeps focus and a 40 px hit area on touch. — Fitts's law. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/icon-button.json
- [Image Cropper](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/image-cropper): Frame a picture by dragging, pinching or scrolling, with keyboard nudges and an aspect lock. The crop it returns can never leave the image. — Direct manipulation. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/image-cropper.json
- [Input](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/input): Single-line text field, 36 px tall to match Button, that moves the invalid state onto its border and ring. — Fitts's law. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/input.json
- [Input Group](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/input-group): One field with text, icons, buttons or a select attached to it, sharing a single border and focus ring, in four layouts. — Law of uniform connectedness. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/input-group.json
- [Input OTP](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/input-otp): One-time code entry drawn as boxes but built on one real input, so SMS autofill, paste, backspace and screen readers all work. — Error prevention. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/input-otp.json
- [Label](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/label): Caption bound to a control: clicking it focuses the field, and it dims when the field is disabled. — Law of proximity. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/label.json
- [Listbox](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/listbox): A list you choose from that stays open, for when seeing every option is the point. — Recognition over recall. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/listbox.json
- [Mask Input](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/mask-input): Formats dates, phone numbers, cards and your own patterns as you type. The caret stays put in the middle and on paste, and deleting across a dash works. — Error prevention. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/mask-input.json
- [Number Input](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/number-input): A field for amounts that clamps to its range, repeats while a button is held and reads formatted text back. — Error prevention. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/number-input.json
- [Password Input](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/password-input): A password field with a reveal button and a caps lock hint, plus a strength meter, a live checklist or a meter on the field edge. — Error prevention. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/password-input.json
- [Radio Group](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/radio-group): One choice from a short list with every option in view, as dots, selectable cards, joined buttons or rows, with arrow keys built in. — Recognition over recall. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/radio-group.json
- [Rating](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/rating): A score picked with a click or the arrow keys, as stars, hearts, a joined number scale or a row of segments, with half steps and a read-only form. — Mental models. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/rating.json
- [Search Field](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/search-field): A search box with a leading icon, clear button, loading state, debounced onSearch and a Mod K hint. Escape clears it. — Doherty threshold. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/search-field.json
- [Segmented Control](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/segmented-control): A short set of mutually exclusive views, always one on, as a thumb in a track, chips, an underline or square icons. — Recognition over recall. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/segmented-control.json
- [Select](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/select): Dropdown for one choice from a list, with a placeholder, groups, a check on the chosen row and full keyboard support. — Default effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/select.json
- [Signature Pad](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/signature-pad): Sign with a finger, pen or mouse in smooth strokes, with undo and SVG or PNG export, and a typed name for anyone using a keyboard. — Accessibility as equivalence. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/signature-pad.json
- [Slider](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/slider): Picks a value or a range by feel, as a thin line, a thick volume track, labelled steps or a value bubble, with full keyboard control. — Direct manipulation. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/slider.json
- [Switch](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/switch): Sliding on/off control whose thumb travels 16 px in 150 ms, mirroring the physical toggle it imitates. — Affordance. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/switch.json
- [Tags Input](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/tags-input): A field for many short values, added with Enter or a comma, or pasted as a whole list at once. — Flexibility and efficiency of use. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/tags-input.json
- [Textarea](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/textarea): Multi-line text field that starts at 64 px and grows with its content, so the answer is never hidden behind a scrollbar. — Chunking. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/textarea.json
- [Toggle](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/toggle): A button that stays pressed, for turning a view or format on and off without leaving the page. — Visibility of system status. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/toggle.json
- [Toggle Group](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/toggle-group): A row of buttons that stay pressed, one at a time or several at once: quiet fill, joined outline, wrapping chips or square icons. — Law of common region. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/toggle-group.json
- [Toolbar](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/toolbar): A row of tools that is one tab stop: arrow keys rove inside it, with groups, separators, links and toggles, and it wraps or scrolls instead of breaking the layout. — Fitts's law. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/toolbar.json

## Navigation

- [App Shell](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/app-shell): The frame of an app: navigation, a top bar and a content region, with a skip link and landmarks, where the content scrolls on its own on wide screens. — Jakob's law. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/app-shell.json
- [Breadcrumb](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/breadcrumb): A trail from the root to the current page, with a nav landmark, a current marker and a middle that collapses into a menu. — Information scent. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/breadcrumb.json
- [Dropdown Menu](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/dropdown-menu): Compact menu of actions that opens from a button and closes on choice, with arrow-key navigation and a destructive variant. — Hick's law. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/dropdown-menu.json
- [Menubar](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/menubar): The row of menus desktop tools are built on, with sub menus, check and radio items, shortcuts and full arrow key movement across the bar. — Jakob's law. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/menubar.json
- [Metro Map](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/metro-map): Lines and stations from data, for a path that branches and meets again: tap a station, walk with the arrow keys. — Spatial memory. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/metro-map.json
- [Navigation Menu](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/navigation-menu): Site navigation with panels that open from the bar, by pointer or keyboard. — Information scent. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/navigation-menu.json
- [Pagination](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/pagination): Moves through a long list in steady chunks, with the window of pages always the same width so controls never shift. — Spatial memory. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/pagination.json
- [Section Index](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/section-index): A numbered map of the chapters in a long read that fills as you go, as a rail, a sticky strip or a one-line counter. — Goal gradient effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/section-index.json
- [Sidebar](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/sidebar): A column of navigation that collapses to icons, nests groups, marks the current page and turns into a drawer on phones. — Spatial memory. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/sidebar.json
- [Steps](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/steps): Shows where someone is in a process, across a line, down a column, as a bar with a count or as numbered rows, with done, current, upcoming and error states. — Goal gradient effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/steps.json
- [Table of Contents](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/table-of-contents): Lists the sections of a page, from data or read from the headings, follows the one being read and jumps to any of them with motion that respects reduced motion. — Visibility of system status. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/table-of-contents.json
- [Tabs](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/tabs): Segmented control that swaps one panel for another in place, so related views share a single spot on the screen. — Chunking. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/tabs.json

## Overlays

- [Action Bar](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/action-bar): Appears when items are selected, with the count, the actions and a way to clear, floating over the page, docked to its edge or sitting in the flow. — Progressive disclosure. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/action-bar.json
- [Alert Dialog](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/alert-dialog): A question that has to be answered before anything else, with focus on the safe answer, a typed confirmation for the worst cases and a bottom sheet on phones. — Error prevention. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/alert-dialog.json
- [Command](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/command): A command palette with its own fuzzy search: groups, shortcuts, recent items, an empty state, full combobox and listbox semantics and a Mod+K helper. — Hick's law. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/command.json
- [Context Menu](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/context-menu): The menu that opens where you press: right-click, long press or the Menu key, with sub menus, check and radio items and shortcuts. — Fitts's law. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/context-menu.json
- [Dialog](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/dialog): Modal surface that dims everything else and holds focus until the user answers one question. — Attention funnel. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/dialog.json
- [Drawer](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/drawer): A panel that slides in from an edge for a side task, so the page you came from stays where you left it. — Spatial continuity. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/drawer.json
- [Floating Panel](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/floating-panel): A movable, resizable window that stays on screen, for tools people keep open beside their work. — User control and freedom. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/floating-panel.json
- [Hover Card](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/hover-card): A preview that appears over a link when the pointer rests on it, laid out for free content, a person, a page or a number. — Progressive disclosure. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/hover-card.json
- [Hover Preview](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/hover-preview): A preview that follows the pointer over a list of links, so people can look before they commit to a click. — Information scent. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/hover-preview.json
- [Popover](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/popover): Small floating panel anchored to the control that opened it, for a form or detail that does not need a full dialog. — Spatial memory. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/popover.json
- [Station Dialog](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/station-dialog): A detail dialog that opens from a point on a map or list, knows where it came from and goes back there on close. — Object constancy. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/station-dialog.json
- [Tooltip](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/tooltip): One-line hint that appears on hover or focus with no delay and leaves with the pointer, for detail that does not deserve screen space. — Progressive disclosure. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/tooltip.json
- [Tour](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/tour): A step-by-step product tour with a spotlight cut-out, anchored to a selector or a ref. It manages focus, scrolls targets into view, follows them on resize and skips the ones that are missing. — Von Restorff effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/tour.json

## Display

- [Accordion](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/accordion): Stacked rows that open in place, so a long page of answers stays short until someone asks for one. — Progressive disclosure. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/accordion.json
- [Aspect Ratio](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/aspect-ratio): Holds the space for media before it arrives, so the page does not jump, with a mat, an overlaid caption or an empty slot. — Layout stability. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/aspect-ratio.json
- [Avatar](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/avatar): A face or initials that identifies a person at a glance, alone or as an overlapping group with a +N. — Recognition over recall. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/avatar.json
- [Badge](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/badge): Small status chip in five variants; the warm mise variant is reserved for the one item that must stand out. — Von Restorff effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/badge.json
- [Before After](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/before-after): Two versions of one thing in the same frame, compared with a divider you drag or a lens that follows the pointer. — Change blindness. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/before-after.json
- [Calendar](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/calendar): A full-size calendar for showing what is on, as a month grid, a week strip, an agenda or a whole year. — Spatial memory. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/calendar.json
- [Card](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/card): Bordered surface with header, content and footer slots that reads as one region before anyone reads the text. — Law of common region. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/card.json
- [Card Deck](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/card-deck): One slide at a time for an argument told in order, moved by swipe, tap, arrow keys or a list of titles. — Chunking. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/card-deck.json
- [Carousel](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/carousel): A row of slides on the browser's own scroll snapping, so swiping feels native and no library is needed. — Direct manipulation. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/carousel.json
- [Chart](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/chart): Bar, line, area and donut charts from one data shape, with axes in round numbers, points you can walk by keyboard and a real table behind them. — Data-ink ratio. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/chart.json
- [Code Block](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/code-block): Readable code without a highlighting library: a small tokenizer for ts, json and bash, line numbers, marked lines, wrap, copy, file tabs and diffs. — Pre-attentive processing. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/code-block.json
- [Collapsible](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/collapsible): One disclosure: a label that opens the detail under it, for the one thing most readers can skip. — Progressive disclosure. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/collapsible.json
- [Color Swatch](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/color-swatch): Shows a colour with its name and value, alone or as a palette, with a label that stays readable on any fill and a checker under transparency. — WCAG contrast. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/color-swatch.json
- [Data Table](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/data-table): Hand it rows and columns and get sorting, a filter box, selection, column visibility, pages and bulk actions, with rows that become cards when the container is narrow. — Recognition over recall. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/data-table.json
- [Decision Cards](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/decision-cards): A record of decisions: the question, what was chosen, what lost and why. — Credibility through trade-offs. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/decision-cards.json
- [Description List](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/description-list): Labels and values on a real dl, as ruled rows, two columns, single lines or tiles, with a slot for a copy button and long values that wrap. — Visual hierarchy. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/description-list.json
- [Flow](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/flow): A process drawn from data, with arrows that can carry words, and no diagram library to load. — Law of continuity. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/flow.json
- [Glass Core](https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/components/glass-core): A glass object for the centre of a hero section, drawn without WebGL and still until you ask it to move. — Aesthetic-usability effect. Install: https://miseui.junsu4621.workers.dev/r/glass-core.json
